opening.argument: The presentation ties participation in OneCoin to mining and creating coins, then gives viewers concrete package-based reasons to commit more codes. It states that banking ten Premium codes into the company yields an additional Premium package, while the Tycoon-to-Premium upgrade is described as providing the maximum tokens through four splits, including 3,360,000 tokens. The audience is also told to promote the packages because doing so can increase position or income stream, and to activate others and move packages while the promotions are temporary. These are direct instructions connecting package commitments, token increases, and audience recruitment to potential returns. The available evidence establishes the promotional structure, but does not establish whether the promised benefits were delivered or transferable.
